_meta.purpose: VL-A-04 (WS3 step 35) — the DETERMINISTIC intake pre-pass lexicon. A PURE, LLM-free classification asset consumed by pythia/reasoning/det_intake.py ONLY when config.intake_det_scan_enabled is True (default OFF). Each rule maps a diacritic-insensitive surface pattern in the raw query to ONE structured IntakeFact {field, value} carrying source='det'. A det fact SKIPS the query-substring grounding check (IV-SPAN) — it is a deterministic classification, not a copied query span — but is STILL gated by the closed-vocabulary field check (IV-ENUM). So every `field` below MUST be a member of intake._FACT_FIELDS.
_meta.status: DRAFT — ADVOCATE/LAWYER REVIEW PENDING. Same posture as data/term_aliases.json: authored deterministically from the corpus register + the layman gold, precision-first, never flipped ON without counsel sign-off (content certification is gate #1).
_meta.matching: Every surface form and the query are ACCENT-FOLDED (NFKD, combining marks stripped) and lowercased before matching, so ASCII surface forms match diacritic Czech ('restauraci', 'osvč', 'v Plzni'). A form is a Python regex evaluated on the folded query. A rule that matches contributes at most ONE fact for its field; the FIRST rule to claim a field wins (add-never-override, so a query naming two legal forms yields one, not a contradiction). A det fact NEVER overrides an LLM/profile fact on the same field at the merge point either.

schema.id: str — stable rule id (used by the test witness map + audit)
schema.group: str — one of: legal_form_alias | gate_cue | regime_alias | municipality
schema.field: str — the IntakeFact.field; MUST be in intake._FACT_FIELDS (IV-ENUM gates it)
schema.value: str — the emitted IntakeFact.value (canonical token for legal_form, 'yes' for a gate, a regime tag for tax, the municipality name for region)
schema.forms: list[str] — accent-folded Python regex patterns; a match on the folded query fires the rule
schema.note: str — the intended statutory/classification hook + the gold witness id(s), for the reviewer only (NOT read by code)

A tiny, safe major-city gazetteer (group d). AQ-05's full gazetteer is NOT reachable here, so this ships as a minimal absent-tolerant surface-form set: a match emits the city NAME as the region value (not the raw span). The rule as a whole is witnessed by 'v Plzni' (emp-first-hire-plzen-01); Praha/Brno/Ostrava carry no gold witness but share the same precise pattern shape and cannot misfire. value='__per_form__' means the value comes from forms_map.
